title: Romualdez expected to arrive in Payatas jail at ‘12 midnight’ — Remulla
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez could be detained at the New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas by “12 midnight” on Tuesday, Interior chief Jonvic Remulla confirmed on…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez could be detained at the New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas by “12 midnight” on Tuesday, Interior chief Jonvic Remulla confirmed on Monday. Earlier, there were reports that Romualdez will arrive at the jail facility no later than 6 p.m. On Monday noon, the Sandiganbayan Third Division ordered to transfer the custody of Romualdez to the jail facility from the Philippine General Hospital (PGH).
